summary: Personality wave 8 (issue #198): reviewed all 79 catalogue Lion Clan Personalities, wired the 17 clearest/most-confidently-buildable of the 66 previously unwired ones using only already-existing primitives plus five small new Target categories (enemy-personality-lower-honor-than-self, personality-chi-lte-self, own-lion-or-fallen-personality, enemy-card-without-attachments, enemy-unit-card-terrain-conditional), a token-gated Additional Action grant, and two passive Force-modifier Effects. Logged a specific, accurate blocker note for each of the other 49 in docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx. Along the way: discovered the local scan-image cache is missing for the entire reference catalogue (a deliberate .gitignore policy, not a bug), downloaded and audited the 'Catalogue artwork - WebP 85 - v1' GitHub Release against every receipt, and recovered/installed 2,485 of 2,952 scans locally via a new reusable tool (tools/content/audit_and_install_scans.py). Per explicit user instruction, the rewritten receipt JSON files (their sha256 now points at the re-encoded local JPEG, not the original master) are kept local/uncommitted, not pushed to git.
validation: dotnet build (0 warnings/errors); dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests -> 113/113 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck-format tests pass (new LionClanPersonalityReview covers all 17 cards); python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/collaboration -> 43/43; python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/content -> 107/107; dotnet run --project tests/L5R.AI.Tests -> 13/13; dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Server.Tests -> 5/5; dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Client.Transport.Tests -> 4/4. tools/check.sh itself could not run in this fresh worktree (NUGET_PACKAGES points at an empty worktree-local cache, causing a cold restore that hangs -- same limitation hit and documented in this session's earlier worktrees), so every constituent check was run directly instead.
remaining: The other 49 unwired Lion Clan Personalities remain blocked on real engine gaps (card creation, broad enemy-action Reaction triggers, a Tactical/Bushido-Virtue action-classification-trigger dispatch, deck search, dual-independent-target abilities, Regions, Rings (Ring of Earth), Engage/Interrupt timing, control-transfer, and several one-off novel mechanics) -- see docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx's Blocker column. The 17 newly-wired cards' scan art (src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/*.jpg) is committed but missing its Godot .jpg.import sidecar (no Godot editor installed in this fresh worktree to generate it) -- same root cause issue #117 already fixed once for 14 other cards; needs a headless Godot reimport pass before these render in the live client instead of a placeholder. PRs #191 (issue #190), #193 (issue #192), and #197 (issue #194) from earlier in this session remain open/unmerged.
